name: Misato Morita
bio: Misato Morita is a Japanese actress who made her way into mainstream success after she appeared in the Netflix series, The Naked Director. Before her debut on Netflix, she has starred in several Japanese TV shows and drama.

credits.title: All the Lovers in the Night
credits.overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.

credits.title: All Our Tomorrows
credits.overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.

credits.title: Until We Meet Again
credits.overview: After failing to land a job, Shimizu Misora stumbles into an internship at funeral company Bando Kaikan and trains under the strict but compassionate Urushibara Reiji. As she learns to care for the bereaved, her discouragement turns into admiration, and a new sense of purpose.

credits.title: 世界の終りとハードボイルド・ワンダーランド
Night Flower
credits.overview: Driven to the brink, Natsuki makes a desperate gamble: selling drugs to make her children's dreams come true. Living a double life—mother by day, dealer by dark—where will this dangerous path lead her—?

credits.title: Rental Family
credits.overview: An American actor in Tokyo struggles to find purpose until he lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese 'rental family' agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. As he immerses himself in his clients' worlds, he begins to form genuine bonds that blur the lines between performance and reality.

credits.title: The Bird Is Calling

credits.title: City Hunter
credits.overview: An exceptional marksman and hopeless playboy, private eye Ryo Saeba reluctantly forms an alliance with his late partner's sister to investigate his death.

credits.title: Sayonara, Band Apart
credits.overview: Kawashima, who harbored a modest dream of pursuing a career in music in Osaka, met a woman named Yuri, and with her encouragement, he took to the stage. This encounter would drastically change the course of Kawashima’s life.

credits.title: Snow Country
credits.overview: Depicts the love story between an idle author and a provincial geisha.

credits.overview: Depressed and in debt, Santoshi tells his young daughter that he is going to find an infamous serial killer and collect a reward. However, when Santoshi disappears without a trace, she starts to fear the worst and begins searching for him.
